toolMode: generate, then edit for transparent sprite-atlas delivery
prompt: Create an original production-ready crisp pixel-art sprite atlas for K.O.R.E. with exactly eight large side-view biome entrances in a clean four-column by two-row grid: Greenhollow mossy timber village gate, Thornwood living-root arch, Ironroot riveted mine portal, Bonevault ossuary crypt door, Emberdeep basalt-and-lava gate, Frostpeak ice-and-stone entrance, Sunscar carved sandstone temple door, and Skyglass luminous crystal sky portal. Each must have a unique silhouette and palette, a readable dark walkable opening, no labels, no logos, no characters, no scenery overlap, and transparent space around every sprite.
visualDirection: Seven user-supplied portal and door references were used only for general silhouette and material direction; no source pixels were imported.
postprocess: Removed the generated checkerboard matte with edge-connected alpha flood fill; retained native 1536x1024 resolution and RGBA color.
